baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive gathering, the twice-realized states, the enemy predicate, and the denial of the worship relation.
baseline_models.mechanism: Forced co-presence reverses the relation sought through worship: its recipients become opposing parties and expressly sever themselves from the devotion directed to them.

activation_trace.role: A group is driven together toward one destination, supplying the compulsory encounter in which the relation is tested.
Occurrence and presence in time make both hostility and repudiation realized states rather than remote possibilities.
The opponent of an ally supplies the direct reversal from presumed patronage to hostility.
Submissive devotion names the prior bond whose expected reciprocity collapses.
Explicit disavowal supplies the act by which the recipients cut themselves loose from that bond.

changed_reading.before: The verse merely predicts that hostile beings will deny a past cult at resurrection.
changed_reading.after: The gathering is a forced relational reckoning: the very recipients from whom alliance was sought reverse position and repudiate the worship that joined the parties.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The worship noun is placed between enemy-making and repudiation, allowing non-ritual power images within its root inventory to remain active.
baseline_models.mechanism: Worship can be carried as a double abasement: devotees submit themselves while also trying to tame, employ, or bind a recipient into serving their needs. Assembly exposes that arrangement as an overreach, so the would-be instrument becomes an adversary.

activation_trace.role: The root's making-someone-servile image exposes a latent attempt to turn the worshipped recipient into an instrument.
Taming and smoothing something for use adds the functional expectation hidden inside the devotional relation.
Crossing a rightful limit marks the attempted power arrangement as transgressive and explains its reversal.
Blocking acknowledged truth makes the final denial an exposure of what the arrangement had concealed.

changed_reading.before: Worship is only a ritual act that its object later rejects.
changed_reading.after: Worship also encodes a failed power bargain: self-abasement sought leverage over a patron, and the attempted instrument refuses that role as an adversary.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The people-root's mapped seeing inventory, gathering, temporal presence, and covering/disavowal converge on public exposure.
baseline_models.mechanism: Assembly does more than collect bodies. It brings perceivers, opponents, and a previously covered relation into one visible present, where denial itself reveals who was never an ally.

activation_trace.role: Perception by sight, hearing, or felt awareness makes the human collective the field in which concealed relations become perceptible.
Directed collection removes separation and stages a shared disclosure.
Presence in a determinate time turns latent allegiance into an observable state.
Covering supplies the hidden condition that the gathered confrontation brings to light.
Open opposition is the disclosed reality beneath the presumed alliance.

changed_reading.before: Gathering is only transport into a later crowd.
changed_reading.after: Gathering is an epistemic exposure: co-presence makes the covered truth of the worship relation visible as opposition and disavowal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding call receives no reply across an extended horizon because its addressees are inattentive; the focus scene then supplies a grim delayed response, in which the first decisive reciprocity is hostility and repudiation.

activation_trace.role: Calling by speech supplies both the repeated address and the relational pull that seeks a respondent.
A verbal answer is explicitly the missing link, turning the focus repudiation into a possible terminal reply.
An extended span of time holds the nonresponse open until the gathering horizon.
Inattention leaves the invocation outside awareness and explains the present silence.
The eventual response takes the relational form of opposition rather than alliance.
Disavowal provides the content of that delayed response.
Devotion is the relation about which the answer is finally given.

structural_cues: 46:5 immediately precedes the focus and moves from repeated invocation through nonresponse to a stated time limit; 46:6 opens with the gathering condition.
The same third-person parties persist across the verse boundary, making a delayed call-and-answer reading grammatically available.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies calling, absent response, inattention, a temporal horizon, and then hostility plus disavowal; I infer that the focus event functions as the call's delayed answer. A live alternative is that the two verses only list separate failures without forming one communication arc.

changed_reading.before: The focus begins an independent scene in which former cult objects suddenly become hostile.
changed_reading.after: The focus completes an unanswered invocation: after prolonged silence, the only decisive answer the worshipper receives is adversarial repudiation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Denial migrates across the relation. People first cover or knowingly reject signs and recode them as deception or fabrication; in the focus, the worshipped parties take up the denying position and reject the worshippers' claim upon them.

activation_trace.role: Rejection of manifest truth establishes denial first as the worshippers' own posture.
Diversion and deception supply the recoding by which what appears clear is dismissed.
Invented falsehood supplies the accusation used to sever a message from its claimed source.
Denial despite knowledge sharpens the earlier posture from mere ignorance to willful repudiation.
The focus transfers repudiation to the worshipped side of the relation.
Hostility is the relational consequence when the denier's own logic returns from the opposite party.

structural_cues: 46:7-11 repeatedly stage hostile renaming of a clear message; 46:26 recalls knowing rejection; the focus places denial in the mouths or stance of the invoked parties instead.
The reversal preserves denial as the repeated action while changing who performs it and what claim is denied.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two differently directed denials and several false renamings; I infer a mimetic reversal in which the worshippers' repudiating practice returns from their supposed allies. The alternative is simple thematic repetition with no transfer between agents.

changed_reading.before: The worshipped parties' denial is an isolated declaration about cultic acts.
changed_reading.after: Their denial mirrors and reverses the worshippers' own habit of recoding truth: repudiation changes sides and becomes the mechanism of enmity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The gathered confrontation behaves like a hearing. An enemy branch can denote seeking redress from an authority; witnesses state what they know, deeds are rendered without deficit, parties are presented, and speech fixes the record. The recipients' disavowal therefore functions as adverse testimony, not only emotion.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge stated as testimony supplies the evidentiary function later assigned to the recipients' denial.
Full rendering without shortfall turns the hearing toward exact settlement of what was done.
Bringing parties out for inspection supplies the public presentation frame.
Spoken answer fixes acknowledgment within that presentation.
A wronged party's appeal for official redress converts generic enmity into an adverse legal position.
Disavowal becomes the negative testimony that defeats the worshippers' asserted relation.
The devotional conduct is the disputed relation entered into the record.

structural_cues: The surah moves through witness language, graded deeds, full settlement, and two scenes of presentation before the focus's relational claims are finally evaluated.
The focus combines a plural adverse party with an explicit denial of a past relation, a shape compatible with contested testimony.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies witness, exact settlement, public presentation, speech, and a legal-redress branch inside the focus enemy root; I infer a hearing in which repudiation operates as adverse evidence. Literal personal hostility remains a live, compatible alternative rather than being displaced.

changed_reading.before: Enemies are simply antagonists who dislike the worshippers.
changed_reading.after: They are adverse parties in a public reckoning, and their denial of worship is testimony that legally undoes the alliance the worshippers thought they possessed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus enemy form has packet-supplied split mappings to return and counting. Contextual recompense, intentional work, degree-by-degree differentiation, and full payment activate those non-dominant branches: acts of worship can return as itemized adversarial counterparts at assembly.

activation_trace.role: Matching an act with its consequence supplies the return mechanism for prior conduct.
Purposeful action identifies what can persist into the later settlement.
Movement by successive degrees makes the settlement differentiated rather than generic.
Completion without deficiency supplies exactness to the return of the acts.
Return after departure makes the former devotional investment come back into the encounter.
Enumeration makes each returned attachment legible as a countable liability.
A counterpart counted alongside another allows an act or attachment to stand opposite its maker.
The devotional acts provide the concrete conduct that returns for settlement.

structural_cues: 46:14-20 repeatedly connect what parties did with differentiated recompense and complete rendering.
The focus uses plural adversaries and a plural possessive relation, which can carry an itemized plurality without requiring it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit accounting language and split focus mappings to return and enumeration; I infer that prior worship can reappear as an adversarial liability. This is form-distant and the ordinary referent remains worshipped beings, so the accounting reading should coexist as an exploratory overlay only.

changed_reading.before: Only external worshipped beings return as enemies.
changed_reading.after: The worship itself can be heard as returning in countable form: each invested attachment stands opposite the worshipper as a fully rendered liability.

context_deltas.mechanism: An apparent cloud is welcomed as rain but proves to be a destroying wind; shortly afterward, the aid root carries a rain-and-relief branch precisely where adopted gods fail to help. This material reversal lets enemy describe a trusted affordance becoming harmful or absent, not only a conscious feeling.

activation_trace.role: Something appearing from one direction supplies the initially promising but underdetermined sign.
Sought rain or rain-like good supplies the benefit projected onto the approaching phenomenon.
The literal movement of air replaces the expected water-bearing benefit with a different material agent.
Comprehensive ruin supplies the harmful outcome of the misread promise.
The root's rain-as-relief image joins the expected weather benefit to the later question of failed aid.
Opposition names the endpoint when what was trusted for benefit instead harms or abandons.
Repudiation is the relational equivalent of the material promise failing at the moment of need.

structural_cues: 46:24-25 reverse an anticipated benefit into destruction; 46:28 then asks why proximity-gods supplied no aid.
The two reversals share an expectation-of-relief structure even though one concerns weather and the other patronage.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the misread cloud, destructive wind, failed divine aid, and a branch that couples aid with rain-relief; I infer a shared affordance-reversal mechanism. The live alternative is that the weather episode and patronage failure are adjacent but mechanically independent.

changed_reading.before: Becoming enemies means that personal agents acquire hostile intent.
changed_reading.after: Enmity can also be functional reversal: what was approached as a source of relief discloses itself as harm or as total non-help.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later recap describes gods deliberately adopted as means of proximity, asks why they gave no aid, and says they were lost from their users. Worship is thus a transaction meant to secure nearness and patronage; the focus shows its terminal reversal into abandonment and disavowal.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate adoption or acquisition supplies the worshippers' active construction of the patronage relation.
An offering used for approach supplies the promised access that motivates the transaction.
Aid and vindicating support name the expected return that never arrives.
Loss of the supposed patrons supplies practical abandonment at the decisive moment.
Devotion is the consideration invested in hopes of proximity and support.
The expected ally's opposite names the transaction's final relational result.
Disavowal cancels the worshippers' claim that the investment created a valid bond.

structural_cues: 46:28 restates the same invoked parties in transactional order: adoption, approach, expected aid, disappearance, and exposure of fabrication.
The focus supplies the face-to-face outcome that the recap's failed aid leaves implicit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adopted proximity-gods, expected help, disappearance, and focus repudiation; I infer that worship was expected to purchase access and patronage. A live alternative is that proximity names only ritual classification and not a consciously transactional motive.

changed_reading.before: Worship creates a vague attachment that later fails.
changed_reading.after: Worship is exposed as a failed proximity-for-aid transaction: the adopted patrons vanish when needed and then deny that the investment ever bound them.

context_deltas.mechanism: A successful address circuit appears after the failed cult: hearers comprehend, hold attentive silence, turn toward their people, relay the call, and demand a response; absence of other patrons closes the contrast. The focus worship is therefore readable as a broken communication circuit whose only ultimate feedback is denial.

activation_trace.role: Hearing that becomes understanding and compliance initiates a genuinely responsive circuit.
Attentive silence is receptive rather than the inattentive silence surrounding the false invocation.
Turning one's face toward a destination supplies the directed relay from reception to community.
Returning an answer is the response demanded from the next hearers in the chain.
The call draws hearers toward a claimant and provides the signal that the circuit carries.
Patronal love and aid define the reciprocal support unavailable outside the successful response.
Devotion is recast as sustained address seeking receptive allegiance.
Repudiation is the failed circuit's final negative feedback.
The nonresponsive addressee resolves as an opponent rather than a patron.

structural_cues: 46:29-32 forms a reception-to-relay sequence, while 46:5-6 forms invocation-to-nonresponse-to-repudiation.
Both sequences use calling and answering vocabulary but yield opposite social networks: warning and response versus false patronage and enmity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two address sequences with opposite outcomes; I infer that the later successful relay diagnoses the focus worship as failed reciprocity. The alternative is that the later sequence illustrates belief generally without commenting on the mechanics of worship in the focus.

changed_reading.before: Worship is a static cultic label, and enmity is its unrelated future punishment.
changed_reading.after: Worship is a failed address network: unlike receptive hearing that becomes response and relay, its calls terminate in silence and finally return as repudiation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Resurrection overcomes the powerlessness of death, presentation exposes parties to inspection, reality is verbally acknowledged, and prior duration contracts to a brief stay. Against that frame, the focus's repeated being-root marks a phase change: hidden relational roles become presently actual at gathering.

activation_trace.role: Loss of life and power supplies the state crossed when the gathered encounter becomes possible.
Exposure for inspection makes the new relational states public and testable.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies what the public acknowledgment confirms.
Remaining in a place supplies the duration that the closing comparison radically compresses.
Twice-stated occurrence and temporal presence actualize hostility and denial at the threshold event.
Directed gathering supplies the threshold at which latent roles become present.
Opposition is one of the relational states actualized by the threshold.

structural_cues: 46:33 states the transition from death to life; 46:34 repeats public presentation; 46:35 collapses remembered duration to a brief interval.
The focus repeats the being-root on both sides of the conjunction, rhythmically marking two simultaneous state realizations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies resurrection, presentation, acknowledged reality, compressed duration, and repeated temporal-state predicates; I infer that gathering actualizes previously hidden roles. The alternative is ordinary past/future predication with no special phase-transition force in the repeated verb.

changed_reading.before: The two predicates simply describe what the parties will feel and say later.
changed_reading.after: The gathering is a state-change threshold: presumed allies are publicly actualized as opponents and repudiators once ordinary time and concealment lose their hold.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-spatial reading uses distant but explicit focus branches: worship can scatter into many directions while gathering can evoke compacted form. It remains anchored in the worship and gathering roots and clarifies their opposition, but downstream prose should present it as a material analogy, not as the lexical sense of either surface form.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The gathering root and the worship root contain opposed images of compaction and dispersal.

activation_trace.role: Dispersal into multiple directions turns misdirected devotions into spatially divergent paths.
A tightly packed bodily form supplies the compression that gathering imposes on those divergent paths.
Opposition is what becomes visible once the dispersed paths are forced into one encounter.

changed_reading.before: Only human bodies are collected at the gathering.
changed_reading.after: The event also compresses worship's scattered directions into one confrontation, where every divergent path resolves into opposition.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The optical projection is surprising because it comes from the people-root's non-dominant mapped eye-image branch, not from ordinary syntax. It remains anchored in that supplied focus mapping plus covering, worship, and enmity, but should be rendered only as a reflexive analogy: it does not establish that the pronouns denote psychological projections.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The mapped inventory for the people-root includes the human figure seen in the eye, beside worship, covering, and opposition.

activation_trace.role: The miniature human figure reflected in the pupil supplies an image of the worshipper encountering a projected likeness.
Devotion directs attachment toward the projected recipient.
Covering allows the worshipper's contribution to the image to remain unrecognized until confrontation.
The reflected construction returns as an opponent rather than confirming the self that invested it.

changed_reading.before: An entirely external object independently turns against the worshipper.
changed_reading.after: As an optical analogy, the worshipper meets a magnified projection of human desire that refuses recognition and returns as an adversarial mirror.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This social analogy is surprising because the parent-child episode does not change the focus pronouns' antecedent. It remains useful through the focus's worship-to-enmity reversal and the context's sustained burden followed by filial disgust, but downstream prose must call it an analogy of asymmetric investment, never a claim that children are the worshipped parties.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus reverses a heavily invested asymmetric bond into hostility and repudiation.

activation_trace.role: Interior bearing and pregnancy supply prolonged embodied investment in a dependent relation.
Hardship borne despite aversion measures the cost invested in that relation.
Parenthood preserves the asymmetric giver-recipient relation across the contextual contrast.
A voiced sign of disgust supplies the shocking repudiation returned by the dependent party.
Sustained devotion supplies the focus's asymmetrical investment.
Opposition supplies the reversal returned by the recipient of that investment.
Disavowal completes the analogy by refusing the bond on which the giver relied.

changed_reading.before: The focus reversal concerns only a doctrinally false cult relation.
changed_reading.after: As a social analogy, it exposes a broader terror of asymmetric investment: long service cannot compel recognition, and the recipient may answer dependence with repudiation.

strongest_changes: 46:5 turns hostility and disavowal into the only delayed answer to a long-unanswered invocation.
Witness, full-settlement, and presentation cues recast the recipients as adverse parties whose denial functions as testimony.
46:28 exposes worship as a failed proximity-for-aid transaction, while 46:29-32 contrast it with a genuinely responsive relay.
The split enemy-root mappings preserve an exploratory reading in which worship returns as an itemized liability.
summary.what_was_special: The focus proved unusually relational: silence becomes a delayed negative answer, presumed patronage becomes adverse testimony, expected relief reverses into harm, and non-dominant return/count branches keep the worship itself active as something that can come back against its practitioner.
remaining_uncertainties: The precise antecedent of the plural parties is supplied by local discourse but remains grammatically less explicit inside the focus ayah alone.
The accounting/return model depends on legitimate packet mappings that are form-distant from the dominant enemy sense and should remain exploratory.
The weather-to-patronage mechanism may be deliberate lexical activation or only a strong adjacency-based analogy.
The power-bargain baseline depends on extending worship-root images of subjugation and taming into motive, not on ordinary ritual syntax alone.
